backend/main.mo: Main backend actor that includes blob storage mixin and exposes four query functions for thumbnail operations: text-to-thumbnail generation, enhancement, video-to-thumbnails extraction, and customization application (all currently return empty/placeholder data).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features with high confidence: text prompt input, image upload, video link input, thumbnail editor, and modern creative visual theme, listing associated files, components, and test IDs for each.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of 11 frontend files describing the main app structure, four input/editor components, gallery display, feature icons, React Query hooks, styling configuration, and application entry point.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles defining comprehensive design tokens using OKLCH color space for light and dark modes, including background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and chart colors with sidebar variants.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, 'Thumbnail Studio' title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component with sticky header, hero section with background image, tabbed interface for three thumbnail creation methods (prompt, upload, video), thumbnail gallery, editor panel, and footer with social links.
frontend/src/components/FeatureIcons.tsx: Component rendering three feature cards in a responsive grid, each displaying an icon image, title, and description for AI generation, smart enhancement, and video analysis capabilities with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/ImageUpload.tsx: Image upload component with drag-and-drop area, file validation (PNG/JPEG, max 10MB), upload progress tracking, preview display, and automatic enhancement via backend actor with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/PromptInput.tsx: Text prompt input component with textarea for thumbnail descriptions, generate button with loading state, backend actor integration for text-to-thumbnail generation, and preview display with toast notifications.
React component for editing thumbnails with customization controls (brightness, contrast, saturation, text overlay) and preview. Includes apply, reset, and download functionality using the backend actor.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailGallery: React component that displays a scrollable grid of generated thumbnails with click-to-select functionality. Shows empty state when no thumbnails exist.
frontend/src/components/VideoLinkInput.t: React component for generating thumbnails from video URLs (YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion). Validates URLs and displays generated thumbnails in a grid.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Custom React Query hooks for thumbnail operations: generating from text, enhancing thumbnails, generating from video, and applying customizations. All mutations invalidate the thumbnails query cache.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file that defines custom theme extensions including color schemes using OKLCH color space, typography with Inter font, container settings, border radius variables, custom shadows, and animation keyframes for accordions.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking an AI-powered thumbnail creation tool with features for generating thumbnails from text prompts, enhancing uploaded images, and creating thumbnails from video links; includes existing and pending feature requests with their implementation status.
